features.title: Add workspaces from the folder browser
features.summary: The header and sidebar Add workspace flows open directly in the Host-backed folder explorer without offering registered projects; one unique typed folder match browses automatically.
failureModes: Directory listing and folder creation use an authenticated Host API; workspace registration stays behind the workspace Remote API.
Ambiguous or truncated path matches do not auto-browse.
The add flow does not expose registered project choices or project registration actions.

features.title: Add a project by cloning a repository
features.summary: New → Clone repository… in the Add workspace flow clones an https, ssh or file:// repository into a new folder in the background with git progress and a Cancel button, colocates jj when it is installed, registers the clone as a project and selects it. The project_clone, project_clone_jobs and project_clone_cancel agent tools drive the same jobs.
failureModes: An existing destination folder is refused before anything runs; a second start for the same folder returns the running job.
A failed or cancelled clone deletes the folder it created and registers nothing; a failed jj colocation keeps the clone and names the command to finish it.
Clone jobs live in Host memory: a Host restart drops the trail, and a clone it interrupted leaves its partial folder.

externalDependencies.boundary: git clone --progress through the Host subprocess service; jj git init --colocate afterwards when jj resolves.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: src/project-lifecycle.test.ts clones a local file:// repository with the real git and jj binaries; cancellation uses a runner that waits for the abort signal.

verification.testName: clones a file:// repository in the background, colocates jj and registers it
cancels a running clone, deletes its partial folder and never registers it

telemetry.testName: clones a file:// repository in the background, colocates jj and registers it

features.title: Remove a project registration
features.summary: Remove a project from the New thread picker without deleting its folder or files; threads lose their project grouping.
reach: expect textbox "Search projects or enter a folder path"
failureModes: Removal requires explicit confirmation.
The folder and files stay on disk; project threads lose their grouping.
If the Host API refuses the request, the project remains listed and the dialog can be retried.

features.title: Create a new project
features.summary: New → New project… in the Add workspace flow creates <parent>/<name> with a colocated jj repository, a README, a described first commit on main, registers it as a project and selects it. Opting in to a private GitHub repository runs gh repo create --private and pushes main when the GitHub CLI is installed. The project_create agent tool takes the same explicit inputs.
failureModes: An existing folder, a missing parent or a missing jj is refused before anything is written.
A failure before registration removes the folder it created, so the same request can be retried.
A GitHub failure after registration keeps the project and shows the gh command to finish it; the GitHub option is hidden while gh is not installed.

externalDependencies.boundary: jj git init --colocate, jj commit and jj bookmark create through the Host subprocess service.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: src/project-lifecycle.test.ts creates the project with the real jj binary in a temporary folder.

externalDependencies.boundary: gh repo create --private --source . --remote origin, then git push of main; only when createGitHubRepository is true.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: src/project-lifecycle.test.ts replaces only the gh process with one that adds a local bare remote, then pushes with the real git.

verification.testName: creates a colocated jj project with a README, a described first commit on main, and registers it
creates a private GitHub repository through gh and pushes main when opted in

telemetry.testName: creates a colocated jj project with a README, a described first commit on main, and registers it

features.title: Search projects and browse folder paths
features.summary: Match registered project labels and canonical directories, browse absolute or home-relative paths through the Host, automatically enter one unique matching folder, open on a Projects scope that leaves JJ thread workspaces out, offer Everything (recents, then projects, then workspaces), Recents and Workspaces scopes, and preserve project identity in returned choices.
failureModes: An empty result remains selectable-safe.
Home-relative paths resolve against the Host-reported home before listing.
A unique folder match browses automatically; ambiguous matches and truncated listings never guess.
Canonical path is returned separately from display name.
Unavailable JJ classification leaves rows unmarked.

verification.testName: searches registered project names and canonical paths
keeps project identity and canonical folder path explicit
resolves home-relative queries using the Host-reported home path
browses one matching directory and keeps ambiguous or incomplete listings explicit
